title: Line 232: broad `except Exception` (BLE001)
detail: Catching `Exception` at line 232 prevents distinguishing expected errors from unexpected failures. Fix: catch specific exception types, or re-raise after logging if a broad catch is intentional.

title: 3× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 130)
detail: At 3 location(s) (first at line 130), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.
